rule_logic: Every active customer must have one unique Customer Identifier
Every active customer must have a populated Full Legal Name
Every populated Date of Birth must be a valid historical calendar date
Consent Status must use an approved enterprise reference value
Every policy must have one unique Policy Identifier
Every active policy must reference a valid Customer Identifier
Policy Expiry Date must not precede Policy Inception Date
Policy Status must use an approved lifecycle reference value
Every claim must have one unique Claim Identifier
Every claim must reference a valid Policy Identifier
Treatment Date must not occur after Claim Submission Date
Approved Reimbursement Amount must match the final approved claim decision
Every healthcare provider must have one unique Provider Identifier
Every active provider must have a verified valid Licence Status
Payment Account Identifier must match the latest approved provider record
Contract Status must use an approved provider lifecycle value
Every financial transaction must have one unique Transaction Identifier
Accounting Date must be a valid date within an open accounting period
General Ledger Account must exist in the approved chart of accounts
Transaction Amount must reconcile with the approved source transaction
